newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Irish Permanent in billion pound note plan.
newsitem.headline: Irish Permanent in billion pound note plan.

text.p: Building society Irish Permanent announced the signing of a 1.0 billion Irish pound Euro note programme to diversify its funding base and increase its presence in international capital markets.

Group Finance Director Peter Fitzpatrick said in a statement:"The establishment of the programme is a major boost to Irish Permanent and provides it with access to an additional 1.0 billion pound borrowing facility."
The society, he said, expected continued strong growth in the home loan market and said the programme would allow Irish Permanent to maintain a dominant position in the market and increase its share.
The programme will facilitate the issuing of notes both on a syndicated and non-syndicated basis denominated in all major currencies for any maturity.
It will be listed on both the London and Dublin stock exchanges.
